unified_identification: Diagram B codes the McMullen Prym eigenform S(1,-2) of discriminant 12. That surface generates the unique closed GL+(2,R)-orbit Omega E_12(4) subset H^odd(4). By Chen-Moller, the KZ positive sum equals 8/5 a.e. on that AIS.
conclusion: Identification with Omega E_12(4); sum 8/5 is Chen-Moller.
